Identity.Name: Pset_StingMEP
Identity.Definition: STING MEP calculation results written and read by the Bonsai add-on (stingtools-bonsai ops/mep_ops.py): Hazen-Williams supply pipe sizing, BS EN 12056-2 discharge units and conduit fill. The add-on wrote this set before it was declared; the property names are the ones it has always used, so files it wrote stay readable. Numbers were written as IfcLabel text before 5.8.0 and as IfcReal / IfcInteger since; the add-on reads both. Property names are the add-on's, not Revit shared-parameter names (the plugin's water-supply sizer writes PLM_SUP_QD_LPS / PLM_SUP_VEL_MPS / PLM_SUP_DN_REQ_MM instead).

Governance.StandardsBasis: Hazen-Williams pipe flow; BS EN 12056-2 (discharge units); BS 7671 Appendix 5 (conduit capacity)

Property.name: PLM_SUP_FLOW_LS
Property.Definition: Supply pipe design flow in litres per second. Read by Calc Pipe Flow (H-W) as the flow to size for, and written back as the full-bore flow of the DN it selects (stingtools-bonsai ops/mep_ops.py).

Property.name: PLM_SUP_DN
Property.Definition: Supply pipe nominal diameter (DN, mm) selected by Calc Pipe Flow (H-W), the smallest DN in the series that carries PLM_SUP_FLOW_LS.

Property.name: PLM_SUP_VEL_MS
Property.Definition: Supply pipe velocity in metres per second at the selected DN (Hazen-Williams, full bore), written by Calc Pipe Flow (H-W).

Property.name: PLM_DRN_DU
Property.Definition: Discharge unit of a sanitary terminal (BS EN 12056-2 Table 1), written by Calc Drainage Units (DU).

Property.name: ELC_CONDUIT_DN_MM
Property.Definition: Conduit internal diameter in millimetres. Read by Calc Conduit Fill; not written by STING.

Property.name: ELC_CABLE_COUNT
Property.Definition: Number of cables in the conduit. Read by Calc Conduit Fill; not written by STING.

Property.name: ELC_CABLE_OD_MM
Property.Definition: Overall diameter of one cable in millimetres. Read by Calc Conduit Fill; not written by STING.

Property.name: ELC_FILL_PCT
Property.Definition: Conduit fill as a percentage of the conduit cross-section, written by Calc Conduit Fill.

Property.name: ELC_FILL_STATUS
Property.Definition: Conduit fill verdict written by Calc Conduit Fill: OK (fill at or below 40 %) or OVERLOADED.
